Get Coin

GET 
/coins/:mint

Gets information about a specific coin by its mint address

Request​

Path Parameters

    mint stringrequired

    The mint address of the coin

    Example: 9LzCMqDgTKYz9Drzqnpgee3SGa89up3a247ypMj2xrqM

Responses​

  • 200

Success

  • application/json
  • Schema
  • Example (from schema)

Schema

    data

    object

    namestringrequired

    The coin name

    Example: Bonk Inu
    tickerstring

    The coin symbol

    Example: $BONK
    mintstringrequired

    The coin mint address

    Example: DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263
    decimalsintegerrequired

    The number of decimals for the coin

    Example: 5
    owner_idstringrequired

    The ID of the user associated with the coin

    Example: 7eP5n
    escrow_recipientstring

    The escrow recipient address for custom-created coins without DBCs

    Example: DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263
    logo_uristring

    URL to the coin's logo image

    Example: https://arweave.net/hQiPZOsRZXGXBJd_82PhVdlM_hACsT_q6wqwf5cSY7I
    banner_image_urlstring

    URL to the coin's banner image

    Example: https://example.com/banner.png
    descriptionstring

    A longform description about the coin

    Example: The Official Bonk Inu token Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit.
    websitestring

    The official website for the coin

    Example: https://www.bonkcoin.com/
    link_1string

    Generic link URL for the coin

    Example: https://x.com/bear_token
    link_2string

    Generic link URL for the coin

    Example: https://instagram.com/bear_token
    link_3string

    Generic link URL for the coin

    Example: https://tiktok.com/@bear_token
    link_4string

    Generic link URL for the coin

    Example: https://bear-token.com
    has_discordbooleanrequired

    Whether the coin has a Discord server

    Example: true
    created_atstringrequired

    The date and time when the coin was added to Audius.

    Example: 2023-10-01T12:00:00Z
    addressstring

    The SPL token mint address

    Example: DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263
    symbolstring

    The token symbol

    Example: BONK
    marketCapnumberrequired

    Market capitalization in USD

    Example: 2625779824.994664
    fdvnumberrequired

    Fully diluted valuation in USD

    Example: 2625779824.994664

    extensions

    object

    Token metadata and links

    coingeckoIdstring

    CoinGecko ID

    Example: bonk
    descriptionstring

    Token description

    Example: The Official Bonk Inu token
    twitterstring

    Twitter URL

    Example: https://twitter.com/bonk_inu
    websitestring

    Website URL

    Example: https://www.bonkcoin.com/
    discordstring

    Discord invite URL

    Example: https://discord.gg/ubqvDDFUhf
    liquiditynumberrequired

    Current liquidity in USD

    Example: 18977326.389274083
    lastTradeUnixTimeintegerrequired

    Unix timestamp of the last trade

    Example: 1752620592
    lastTradeHumanTimestringrequired

    ISO8601 time of the last trade

    Example: 2025-07-15T23:03:12
    pricenumberrequired

    Current price in USD

    Example: 0.000029571022098881748
    history24hPricenumberrequired

    Price 24 hours ago in USD

    Example: 0.000027195701160436288
    priceChange24hPercentnumberrequired

    24h price change in percent

    Example: 8.73417796596848
    uniqueWallet24hintegerrequired

    Unique wallets traded in last 24h

    Example: 20242
    uniqueWalletHistory24hintegerrequired

    Unique wallets traded in previous 24h

    Example: 21155
    uniqueWallet24hChangePercentnumberrequired

    24h change in unique wallets (percent)

    Example: -4.315764594658473
    totalSupplynumberrequired

    Total supply of the token

    Example: 88795707372386.03
    circulatingSupplynumberrequired

    Circulating supply of the token

    Example: 88795707372386.03
    holderintegerrequired

    Number of markets the token is traded on

    Example: 317

    totalVolumeUSDnumberrequired

    Total volume of coin traded in USD (all time)

    sellintegerrequired

    Example: 170693395

    dynamicBondingCurve

    object

    required

    Information about the dynamic bonding curve if one exists for the Coin

    addressstringrequired

    Address of the bonding curve pool

    Example: 2AAsAwNPTNBk5N466xyPiwqdgbc5WLbDTdnn9gVuDKaN
    pricenumberrequired

    Current price in the pool's quote token (e.g., AUDIO)

    Example: 0.0028402095736478586
    priceUSDnumberrequired

    Current price in USD

    Example: 0.000029571022098881748
    curveProgressnumberrequired

    Progress along the bonding curve (0.0 - 1.0)

    Example: 0.75
    isMigratedboolean

    Whether the bonding curve has been migrated

    Example: false
    creatorQuoteFeenumberrequired

    Creator quote fee for the bonding curve

    Example: 0.05
    totalTradingQuoteFeenumberrequired

    Total trading quote fee accumulated

    Example: 0.001
    creatorWalletAddressstringrequired

    Address of the pool creator's wallet

    Example: 2AAsAwNPTNBk5N466xyPiwqdgbc5WLbDTdnn9gVuDKaN

    artist_fees

    object

    Information about the fees earned by the artist on the coin's trading.

    unclaimed_feesnumber

    Total unclaimed fees from all sources, in $AUDIO.

    Example: 2000000000
    total_feesnumber

    Total fees earned from all sources, in $AUDIO.

    Example: 4000000000

    artist_locker

    object

    Information about the artist locker associated with the coin.

    addressstring

    The address of the artist locker.

    Example: 9bC8rd4qy4EQTHjvCoKFttk5W5km4tUFcVfASCDGro84
    lockednumber

    The amount currently locked in the artist locker.

    Example: 499178082191780800
    unlockednumber

    The amount currently unlocked in the artist locker.

    Example: 821917808219178
    claimablenumber

    The amount claimable from the artist locker. Eg. the amount unlocked that hasn't already been claimed.

    Example: 821917808219178

    reward_pool

    object

    Information about the reward pool associated with the coin.

    addressstring

    The address of the reward pool.

    Example: 6qUSoiMbTEZ4hpN3kuk5bjCRgcTJgUfXftVfTH1CSvZE
    balancenumber

    The current balance of the reward pool.

    Example: 1000000000
